prompt.adult: According to Proverbs 1:7, the fear of the LORD is the beginning of what?

verses.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, But fools despise wisdom and instruction.

explanation.adult: Proverbs 1:7 contrasts the wise and fools. Read the first line.
explanation.child: Read Proverbs 1:7. The first part tells what the fear of the LORD begins.
explanation.teen: Check Proverbs 1:7. The first line finishes the sentence.
explanation.older: The opening line of Proverbs 1:7 completes the statement about the fear of the LORD.

teaching.extended_explanation: "Fear of the LORD" means deep respect for God. The first line of the verse says where that respect leads first.
teaching.takeaway: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge.
